moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此规则匹配后停止后续规则

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Syncing now; new mail shows in the Inbox as it arrives
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 正在同步；新邮件到达时显示在收件箱

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Text members a person adds in a day
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 一个人一天添加的短信成员
一个聊天室的短信成员

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 达到阈值的外部号码短信进入每个用户聊天中的垃圾与已屏蔽，且不通知他们；不会丢弃任何内容。此处有人认识、信任或发过短信的号码不作判定。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Texts in a day per room
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 每个聊天室每天的短信

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: That is not a place: coordinates, a geo: link, a maps link or an address
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 这不是地点：坐标、geo: 链接、地图链接或地址

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The account is ready. Open the Inbox to read its mail.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 账号已就绪。打开收件箱以阅读其邮件。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The devices could not be opened. Check microphone and camera permissions and availability, then try again.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 无法打开设备。请检查麦克风和摄像头的权限与可用性，然后重试。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The draft could not be saved.
The files could not be kept
The key backup was not set up
The mailbox is full: new mail waits at the sender until you delete some, or a mail administrator raises its quota
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 邮箱已满：新邮件在发件方等待，直到您删除一些，或邮件管理员提高配额

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The message keeps its own copy
The microphone level could not be tested. Check browser audio support and try again.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 无法测试麦克风电平。请检查浏览器的音频支持并重试。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The password is shown only now. Copy it into the phone before you close this.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 密码只显示这一次。请在关闭前把它复制到电话中。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The phone stops working until you enter the new password in it.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 在电话中输入新密码之前，它将停止工作。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The recording could not be read
The registrar is off on this server: phones cannot register until an administrator turns it on (sip-server/registrar@enabled).
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此服务器上的注册器已关闭：在管理员开启之前，电话无法注册（sip-server/registrar@enabled）。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The registrar is off on this server: the phone can register once an administrator turns it on.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此服务器上的注册器已关闭：管理员开启后，电话即可注册。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The room's default: all messages, mentions in a public room
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 聊天室的默认：所有消息，公开聊天室中的提及

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The rule could not be tried
The same reply on all my accounts
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 我的所有账号使用同一回复

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The sent message shows in this record's Chatter
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 已发送的消息显示在此记录的讨论中

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The server cannot read the links of an encrypted room: see them in a browser
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 服务器无法读取加密聊天室的链接：请在浏览器中查看

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The server's sticker packs are for sticker administrators.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 服务器的贴纸包仅供贴纸管理员使用。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The server's sticker packs, offered to every chat user beside their own.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 服务器的贴纸包提供给每位聊天用户，与其自己的贴纸包并列。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The setting could not be saved. Try again.
The SMS or RCS bridge its texts go through (System, Chat Bridges); empty for none. An RCS bridge sends RCS first, from the brand's agent; the system's number stays on SMS
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 其短信经过的 SMS 或 RCS 桥接（系统、聊天桥接）；留空表示没有。RCS 桥接先从品牌代理发送 RCS；系统号码仍走 SMS

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The sum of the weights of the rules a text matches
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 一条短信所匹配规则的权重之和

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Their calls are refused, and their texts go to Spam & blocked in Chat without notifying you.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 他们的来电会被拒绝，短信进入聊天中的垃圾与已屏蔽，且不通知您。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Their messages are hidden from you in shared rooms and do not notify you, their calls do not ring you, and they cannot start a chat with you or add you to a room. They are not told.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 在共享聊天室中，他们的消息对您隐藏且不通知您，他们的来电不让您振铃，他们也不能与您开始聊天或把您加入聊天室。不会告知他们。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Then 7 deletes a message, 9 saves it, # skips to the next.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 然后，7 删除一条消息，9 保存，# 跳到下一条。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This account has no incoming mailbox to sync
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此账号没有可同步的收件邮箱
此浏览器无法录制音频

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This browser did not start over
This browser has no encryption keys yet.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此浏览器还没有加密密钥。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This browser's encryption keys that cannot be opened are deleted, and it gets a new device. Messages it read before come back from your key backup: restore it with your recovery key next.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此浏览器无法打开的加密密钥会被删除，并得到一个新设备。它以前读过的消息会从密钥备份中回来：接下来请用恢复密钥恢复。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This copy is no longer kept on this computer.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此副本不再保存在这台计算机上。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This device could not keep the draft. Check available storage and try again.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此设备无法保存草稿。请检查可用存储并重试。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This draft changed elsewhere. Your changes are still open here.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此草稿已在别处更改。您的更改仍在此处打开。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This list was changed: read it again from the start
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此列表已更改：请从头重新阅读

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This mailbox is private: its posts show once an owner accepts your request.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此邮箱是私密的：所有者接受您的请求后才会显示其帖子。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This message cannot wait to be sent
This needs a connection to the server: try again when it is back
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 这需要连接到服务器：恢复后再试

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This room sends its messages only to verified devices: a member verifies your device first.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此聊天室只把消息发给已验证的设备：须先由一名成员验证您的设备。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This starts a new key backup with a new recovery key. Keys only in the current backup (older messages this browser never read) are not copied to it. Restore with your current recovery key first if you still have it.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 这将用新的恢复密钥开始一份新的密钥备份。仅存在于当前备份中的密钥（此浏览器从未读过的较早消息）不会复制过去。如果您还有当前恢复密钥，请先用它恢复。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This thread is closed: no more replies in the mailbox.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此邮件串已关闭：邮箱中不再有回复。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: To: people or a phone number
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 收件人：人员或电话号码

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Transcription is off here, so there is no transcript to send.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此处已关闭转写，因此没有可发送的转写文本。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Try the conditions on the newest 50 messages of a folder: the matches are listed, and nothing is done to them.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 在一个文件夹最新的 50 封消息上试用条件：列出匹配项，不对它们做任何操作。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: View-once photo: open it in the app
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 阅后即焚照片：在应用中打开
语音留言已移到已删除

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Waiting for microphone and camera access. Check the browser permission prompt.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 正在等待麦克风和摄像头权限。请查看浏览器的权限提示。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Waiting to send: it goes when the server can be reached
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 等待发送：能连上服务器时发出
屏幕阅读器朗读的内容

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: When nobody answers and the group's fallback is its voicemail, callers hear this greeting and leave a message its members read in Calls, Voicemail.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 当无人接听且群组的回退是其语音信箱时，来电者听到此问候语并留言，成员在通话、语音信箱中阅读。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Why a text is spam, in its room's banner
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 一条短信为何是垃圾，显示在其聊天室的横幅中

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Words, a host (bit.ly, *.example), a number or a prefix ending in *, a line type (nonFixedVoip)
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 词语、主机（bit.ly、*.example）、号码或以 * 结尾的前缀、线路类型（nonFixedVoip）

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: You are reading this mailbox without being a member: join to post and to get its posts.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您正在阅读此邮箱，但还不是成员：加入后才能发帖并收到其帖子。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: You are told of each new voicemail here and on your devices. An email is optional.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 每条新语音留言都会在此处和您的设备上通知您。电子邮件是可选的。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: You may read this account but not send from it
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您可以阅读此账号，但不能从中发送

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: You need an account on this server to join. Ask the person who shared the link.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 加入需要此服务器上的账号。请向分享链接的人询问。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Your changes have not been saved. Keep this message open and try again.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您的更改尚未保存。请保持此消息打开并重试。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Your location could not be found: enter the place
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 找不到您的位置：请输入地点

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Your mail is ready in the Inbox. New mail appears as the account syncs.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您的邮件已在收件箱就绪。账号同步时会出现新邮件。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Your request is with the room's moderators. You will hear when they decide.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您的请求已交给聊天室的主持人。他们决定后您会得知。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Your request went to the room's moderators
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您的请求已发给聊天室的主持人

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Your version, kept as a copy: the draft was changed elsewhere, and that one stays as it is. This is a new draft.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 您的版本已另存为副本：草稿已在别处更改，那一份保持原样。这是一份新草稿。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Your voicemail can no longer be reached by phone.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 已无法通过电话进入您的语音信箱。
